name: smooth_local_bond_geometry
hypothesis: Formation energy and on-hull probability depend on realized periodic local bonding: smoothly counted contacts near the sum of covalent radii encode coordination, bond-length strain, chemical ordering, and electronegativity contrast that global composition and minimum-distance features omit.
scope: DFT-relaxed crystals with valid covalent radii and neighbor edges through 6 A; Pauling-electronegativity terms use only edges whose endpoint values are finite. Contact weight is exp(-(q/1.20)^6), q=d/(r_cov,i+r_cov,j). No oxidation states or ionic radii are inferred.
falsification: Falsified on adaptive development if adding these ten descriptors fails to lower formation MAE and also fails to lower hull logloss relative to the fixed raw30 HGB baseline; strong train-only improvement with unchanged/worse validation will be treated as overfit.
